notes: Gap neutral convention avoids reusing ITU internet/broadband/mobile indicators already inside AIPI digital infrastructure.
mu_t0 is derived by logit inversion; primitive is q_use_target.
Historical MFC percentiles discipline plausibility; channel mode remains primary and no independent MFC draw is mixed in.
lambda_AI_Kbase mirrors lambda_AI under subset convention so omega_K_net can subtract AI rents.
chi_Kbase/chi_dom=1 and psi_shift=0 because tau_K_eff is broad effective capture; no extra base discount is applied.
tau_C_eff is observed effective VAT over consumption; exempt_C=0 in base-side channel to avoid applying exemptions twice.
Admin, transition, and fixed leakage components are registered as separate cost terms and not embedded in MFC.
pb_gap anchor is stored in percentage points of GDP; sPB_plus_gdp_ratio divides by 100 before joining cost ratios.
